data.exact_reserve_text: In 2016, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 1.8 million on prior year reserves. This has been primarily generated by better than expected claims experience on the property reinsurance class of business.
data.standardized_narrative: In 2016, Syndicate 6117 reported an overall surplus of GBP 1.8 million on prior year reserves, indicating a release. This favorable development was primarily attributed to better than expected claims experience, specifically within the property reinsurance class of business. The reported figure is likely net of reinsurance, as no gross prior year development figure was explicitly stated or reliably calculable from the limited claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: overall surplus of GBP 1.8 million on prior year reserves
better than expected claims experience on the property reinsurance class of business.
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of -1.8m is explicitly stated as an 'overall surplus' in the narrative, which is assumed to be net of reinsurance as no gross figure was explicitly stated or reliably calculable from the limited claims development table. The claims development table on page 8 only provides data for 3 underwriting years (2014-2016) and is noted as being incomplete due to transitional rules of FRS 103, making a comprehensive gross PYD calculation from it unreliable.
